what: G2 review Aha! (Sep 11, 2026): roadmap tool called overpriced; reviewer says product roadmap is commoditized and they replaced it with AI + Jira/Asana/Productboard. Pain: price vs value + manual config.
why_us: Повторяющийся demand gap: PM-инструменты дорожают, покупатели уходят в AI-самоделку. Можно микро-SaaS: AI roadmap из tickets/Slack без enterprise-цены.
revenue: Aha! enterprise pricing; willingness to replace with cheaper AI stack

revenue: QBO Plus +40% hike; SMB accounting spend
engagement: G2 review Jul 28 2026, category page live Sep 18

what: Trustpilot Warp.dev: 5→1 star after «Build Plan». BYOK ломается, нет Anthropic prompt caching — Opus по полному input на каждый запрос. Support шлёт в GitHub. Другие: waste of money, usage limits.
why_us: Боль AI-dev-tooling: скрытый token cost + сломанный BYOK. Спрос на честный agent terminal с caching и прозрачными лимитами.

what: HN Ask: LinkedIn job search replaced decent filters with fuzzy AI search. People asking for alternatives; hiring.cafe / searchforjobs.app recommended.
why_us: Свежая боль рынка труда 2026: AI-search ломает precision. Job-board с жёсткими фильтрами без LinkedIn-tax.
engagement: Ask HN ~1 day ago, active comments

what: Indie builder @carlmonkft: first app failed after 2 years organic (30M views). Before $10k MRR learned: don't rely on organic, kill flops in 2 weeks via download-to-paid/trial data. Screen-time niche hard.
why_us: Свежий (сегодня) high-engagement пост с конкретной воронкой и антипаттернами. Урок дистрибуции для consumer apps.

what: HeyReach (@nikolak47) hit $18M ARR bootstrapped, 7500+ customers, 73%+ EBITDA. Growth slowed to ~7% MoM; TAM exhaustion on agency niche; shifting to GTM/sales + AI-first. Voice Notes was #1 requested feature for 18 months.
why_us: Редкие честные цифры + feature-gap (voice notes) и урок: не копировать конкурентов пока tech не готов. Планируют второй продукт 5–10x.
revenue: $18M ARR, ~7% MoM, path to $20M this year

what: Higgsfield AI creative suite: $1B ARR in 18 months, 30M users, Fortune 500, 400 people. $100M→$1B ARR in 10 months. Application-layer AI video/creative.
why_us: Бенчмарк AI wrapper/suite 2026: application layer, не foundation model. Enterprise adoption 10x since June.

what: Hunter J. Isaacson: at 22 built #1 app worldwide, 100M downloads, $20M ARR (BagsApp / acquired products).
why_us: Consumer app scale-benchmark; сигнал что hit-apps всё ещё дают 8-значный ARR.

what: SmoothCapture (screen recorder) added subscriptions 15 days ago: $111 revenue, $90 MRR, 3 churns. Founder projects $1k MRR in ~5 months at current rate.
why_us: Микро-SaaS с ранней монетизацией. Конкретика trial→paid и churn на старте.

why_us: Спрос на multi-model API gateway без сгорающих кредитов. Классический infra-wrapper.

what: Capterra Sellsy reviews: annual-only lock-in after 14-day trial, ~€95/user/mo plus paid modules (treasury +€45). Users compare cheaper combo Pennylane+€29 / Yousign+€11 / HubSpot starter €20.
why_us: EU SMB all-in-one CRM/finance боль: opaque add-ons + yearly trap. Спрос на monthly unbundled stack.
